fields.label: API-Football Key
fields.description: api-sports.io API key used by the fixture/result sync tasks. Falls back to the site config key 'betassist_api_football_key' when empty. Never commit this value to any repository.

fields.label: Sync League IDs (JSON)
fields.description: JSON object mapping the Match doctype league labels to API-Football league ids, e.g. {"PSL": 288, "EPL": 39}. Leave empty to use the built-in default map.

fields.label: Fixture Sync Horizon (Days)
fields.description: How many days ahead the daily fixture sync pulls scheduled matches.

fields.label: Why Win / Why Lose Insight Engine
Analysis Lead Time (Hours)
fields.description: Generate the pre-match analysis when kickoff is within this many hours (blueprint default: 48h).

fields.label: Insight Provider URL
fields.description: Chat-completions-compatible endpoint used to author the plain-English analysis. Leave empty to use the deterministic statistical fallback writer.

fields.label: Insight Provider Key
fields.description: Bearer key for the insight provider. Falls back to the site config key 'betassist_insight_provider_key' when empty. Never commit this value to any repository.

fields.label: Insight Model
fields.description: Model identifier passed to the insight provider. Required when a provider URL is configured; deliberately has no default.

fields.label: Insight Max Tokens
fields.description: Token budget for a single generated analysis.
